subject: [CMake] Check both arm64 and aarch64 for ARM based system architecture (#1829)
reason: The change is a build-system-only fix: cmake/Modules/ValkeySetup.cmake now sets BUILDING_ARM64 when CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR is 'aarch64' as well as 'arm64'. It modifies no runtime source code, commands, replication, persistence, or protocol behaviour — it only corrects architecture detection during CMake configuration on Linux ARM hosts. There is no runtime behaviour difference between the change and its parent for a fuzzer scenario to reach, so no scenario is needed.
